Research firms, including Nirmal Bang Institutional Equities, IDBI Capital, Ashika and Samco Wealth, have picked 41 unique stocks, along with two US-listed exchange-traded funds (ETFs), for investors to consider during the new Samvat year.
Samco Securities has unveiled a basket of 12 investment ideas for Samvat 2083, spanning key domestic sectors and international exchange-traded funds (ETFs).

Samco Wealth’s Muhurat Trading Picks for Samvat 2083
Samco Wealth has recommended 10 Indian stocks and two US-listed ETFs for Samvat 2083, with holding periods ranging from three months to the long term.

According to Samco, Samvat 2082 will be remembered as the year Indian equities stood still while the rest of the world moved. “The Nifty began the year at 25,869 on Muhurat 2025 and ended it at 23,053 on 30 October 2026, a fall of 10.9%. The Sensex lost 11.8%. FMCG (-23%) and IT (-8%) were among the laggards, while pharma (+20%) and metals (+15%) were the only large sectors to deliver double digit gains,” it said.

The brokerage highlighted the importance of diversification, pointing to the contrasting performance of global markets and Indian equities. It said its Samvat 2083 portfolio was designed to offer exposure to different sectors while also hedging against risks arising from higher crude oil prices and rupee depreciation.
The lesson of the year is simple: concentration hurts, diversification protects. That is the theme of this Muhurat, said the brokerage.

For Samvat 2083, the Samco has handpicked twelve ideas from across categories. Ten are Indian stocks spread across power, capital-market infrastructure, IT services, aerospace and defence engineering, data-centre and telecom equipment, music and automobiles. Two are US ETFs that hedge the basket against the two biggest risks the brokerage sees - rising oil prices and a weaker rupee. Holding periods range from three months to the long term.
